name: Expression Hotspots (Getis-Ord Gi*)
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: Where one gene forms clusters of high or low expression.
citation: Getis & Ord (1992) Geographical Analysis 24(3):189-206; Ord & Getis (1995) Geographical Analysis 27(4):286-306.

params.name: gene
params.label: Gene
params.help: Selects the gene analyzed for expression hotspots and coldspots.

params.name: k
params.label: Neighbours (k)
params.help:
Sets how many nearest neighbours are examined around each cell.
Smaller values detect finer patterns; larger values detect broader patterns.

params.name: normalize
params.label: Expression values
params.help:
Sets the expression scale used in the calculation.
log1p(CP10K) is recommended for most datasets; choose raw counts only when the original counts are required.

params.name: alpha
params.label: Significance threshold
params.help: Sets the largest p-value, or q-value when FDR correction is enabled, at which a cell is classified as a significant hotspot or coldspot.

params.name: fdr
params.label: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR
params.help:
Corrects for testing many cells at once.
When disabled, significance is based on uncorrected p-values and may include more false-positive hotspots or coldspots.
